title: SWAP Core Invariant Audit for Restricted One-Day WOFOST Rate Evaluator Readiness

audit.name: Kernel los van I/O
audit.basis: provider contract contains no file, parser, unit or path dependency; legacy crop parsing remains adapter work

audit.name: Expliciete datascheiding
audit.basis: immutable parameters, dynamic state view, forcing/context, accepted aggregates and event-local output are separate contracts

audit.name: Compacte persistente state
audit.basis: rate evaluator adds no persistent rate state; seven-day Tmin memory remains the compact F-WOF26 continuation; post-threshold GLAIEXP compatibility remains one conditional scalar

audit.name: Scratch per worker
audit.basis: PGASS and all algebraic intermediates are event-local/worker scratch; no WOFOST_rates object is persisted per column

audit.name: Schaalbare geheugenlayout
audit.basis: logical DTOs do not prescribe AoS storage; immutable parameter sets are shareable by template/reference and event scratch can be worker-local

audit.name: Transactionele tijdstappen
audit.basis: provider is read-only; F-WOF26/F-KT retain checkpoint, candidate mutation, commit and rollback authority

audit.name: Goedkope herberekening en warm start
audit.basis: rate evaluation is deterministic from immutable parameters, the same pre-event view, forcing and accepted aggregates; no hidden mutable provider history exists

audit.name: Tijd is generiek
audit.basis: F-WOF27 admits one explicit crop-day event because B1.10 crop evolution is daily, but provider has no calendar, midnight, month or year identity; subdaily soil/coupling steps remain independent

audit.name: Massabehoud is absoluut
audit.basis: crop rate evaluation does not own water transfer; RELTR consumes accepted root-uptake/transpiration aggregates and cannot rewrite them

audit.name: MultiSWAP is primaire use case
audit.basis: parameters are shareable, state view is compact scalar data, rates are call-local and no heavy solver/provider instance is required per column

audit.name: SWAP-fysica maximaal hergebruiken
audit.basis: rate formulas are source-bound to B1.10 while legacy globals/types are deliberately not reused

audit.name: Fysische opties en solverpolicy gescheiden
audit.basis: IDSL/SWRD/nutrients/oxygen are explicit physical scope gates; no numerical performance policy changes crop physics

audit.name: Reference mode blijft beschikbaar
audit.basis: CFRDM, RELMF and B1.10 post-LAIEXP carryover are preserved in the restricted reference target instead of silently normalized to another WOFOST lineage

audit.name: Optionele functionaliteit schaalt met gebruik
audit.basis: nutrient, oxygen, SWRD=3, potential-shadow, soybean and grass inputs/state are absent from the admitted provider contract

audit.name: Runtime/coupler organiseert systeemcompositie
audit.basis: accepted IQROT/IPTRA provenance belongs to runtime/F-KT; crop provider sees only the semantic accepted-window values

audit.name: Geen stille afhankelijkheden
audit.basis: ASTRO/daynr, RAD global, KDIF global, Tmin module history, parser state and daily integral globals have all been surfaced as explicit inputs or owner contracts

audit.name: Iedere architectuurwijziging toetsen
audit.basis: this artifact records the explicit audit before production rate physics is admitted

open_architectural_items.item: semantic read-only WOFOST rate-state view assembly
open_architectural_items.reason: current owner does not expose WST/WSO/WLV/LAIEXP through a dedicated semantic view; direct binding to owner%biomass internals would create an undesirable dependency

open_architectural_items.item: accepted aggregate provenance token or runtime binding
open_architectural_items.reason: scalar IQROT/IPTRA values cannot prove accepted-window lineage or exactly-once aggregation
wofost_one_day_rate_packet_t currently lives in the F-WOF26 structural module; importing it is acyclic but semantically consumer-owned
